title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Payment Plans for Current-Year Balances
content:
## Terms

A family of the current school year that cannot pay its Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program balance at once may ask for a payment plan. The family makes the plan's first payment itself, through the district's online payment portal or at the campus cashier. The support desk quotes the amount and never takes card details. The payment posts to the enrollment.

When at least the suspension minimum of tuition remains unpaid more than the suspension period after a month's due day, care is still suspended, except on an enrollment of the current school year whose family has paid the first payment of a payment plan under this policy and pays each later plan payment by the next tuition due day. Tuition still continues to post while care is suspended, because the seat is held.

## When the first payment is fixed

The first plan payment is not fixed until the enrollment's most recently recorded chargeable late pickup carries its late pickup fee entry.

The first plan payment is fixed only after the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge carries its late payment fee entry whenever any part of that month's tuition was left unpaid on its due day.

The first plan payment is fixed only after the enrollment's most recent drop-in booking request that is received or completed carries its booked-day fee entry whenever the booked day owes a fee.

## Invocation: `pay_extended_day_settlement_f9b88247`

This is the family's own payment tool. The agent unlocks `pay_extended_day_settlement_f9b88247` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, paying in person through the online payment portal or at the campus cashier. One run books one family payment on the enrollment's billing history, dated the day it is made, and issues a confirmation number. The enrollment's balance due goes down by the amount paid.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `care_enrollment_id` | the Extended Day enrollment reference number the payment is for, as read out by the support desk from the Extended Day enrollment lookup | identifier |
| `payment_amount` | the amount paid in US dollars | a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, half a cent rounding up; zero or negative amounts are not accepted |
| `payment_method` | how the family pays | `online_card` (debit or credit card through the online payment portal), `ach_bank_draft` (bank draft through the online payment portal), `personal_check` (personal check at the campus cashier), `money_order` (money order at the campus cashier); `not_applicable` is never a family payment method and a run carrying it is refused |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the payment's confirmation number (ten digits), the payment entry reference number (text beginning `cpy_`), the enrollment reference number, the amount paid in dollars with two decimals, the method and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Its presence means the payment is booked. A sentence beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked. That happens for a method outside the four listed, for an amount that is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places, or when no Extended Day enrollment has the reference number given.
